scope: Stage11 static ownership map for six shared generated Sprite/Texture catalogs; no Unity changes

catalogs.generated: Texture2D PNG decode + Sprite per key
catalogs.actualConsumers: GameFieldView Bomb/Blast SpriteRenderers are current product direct consumers. Sword/knife/bolt raw assets are available; ActionAppearance/ProjectileAppearance can borrow supplied sprites but no automatic catalog call there.
catalogs.currentRelease: Only failed LoadImage texture cleanup; no cache shutdown.
catalogs.leaseBoundary: GameFieldView holds borrow for generated bomb/blast renderers until reference clear/World release. Explicit external appearance registration must retain its own lease if it uses shared props.

catalogs.generated: Color and grayscale Texture2D/Sprite pair per icon
catalogs.actualConsumers: CombatStatusIconStrip children in BattleView player HUD and EnemyView boss status Canvas. Pool-like reusable Image slots.
catalogs.currentRelease: Strip.Clear hides slots but keeps sprite refs; no catalog teardown.
catalogs.leaseBoundary: Strip owns pair borrow(s) while slots reference sprites; release on Destroy or null slot sprites before early release. Root-hold must not substitute for borrower ownership.

catalogs.actualConsumers: CardAttackPropertyIcons under Text in card/recipe/Custom detail surfaces.
catalogs.currentRelease: OnDisable Show(empty) nulls slot sprites; no catalog shutdown.
catalogs.leaseBoundary: Row-level borrow acquisition in Show and release after nulling slots; Destroy cleanup also required even if inactive.

catalogs.actualConsumers: Non-Mono ActorConditionVisual instances created by GameFieldView player and EnemyView enemy; each owns a renderer GameObject.
catalogs.currentRelease: Instance Dispose destroys renderer only; static art retained.
catalogs.leaseBoundary: Non-Mono Visual owns borrow, releases only after renderer sprite cleared/destroyed; Clear hides renderer and currently retains its sprite.

catalogs.currentRetention: static sprites dictionary; static contentBounds is managed metadata
catalogs.actualConsumers: Non-Mono DefensiveFieldVisual instances owned by GameFieldView and EnemyView.
catalogs.currentRelease: Instance Dispose destroys field renderer GameObject only; no art shutdown.
catalogs.leaseBoundary: Visual borrow independent from owner Root lifetime; contentBounds/import source are not generated Unity assets to destroy.

catalogs.actualConsumers: BattleView transformationEffect Image, reset hides parent but retains sprite.
catalogs.leaseBoundary: BattleView holds effect borrows until Image sprite reset/null and final Release/OnDestroy; do not destroy art merely at animation hide.

importBoundary: TextAsset PNG bytes, source font/texture assets and Resources.Load imported objects are borrowed. Destroy generated Sprite first, then only its generated Texture. Color/gray pair must each be destroyed once; never Destroy imported bytes or source texture.
designRecommendations: ResourceManager can own a generic generated-asset cache/lease implementation in Unity assembly; Presentation enums/catalogs must not introduce Unity->Presentation asmdef dependency. Use stable namespaced keys and factory-owned generated payloads.

Root hold lease keeps useful cache across host/view reconstruction; each renderer/Image owner holds its own borrow. Root.Dispose drops only its hold and prevents new acquisitions from that disposed service; existing borrows stay valid until release.
Explicitly decide multiple-Root/new-Root behavior: do not route old borrowers through a mutable global current Root. Old-cache leases must remain tied to their original owner/generation.
Clear Unity references before releasing borrows, especially reusable hidden icon slots and hidden transformation Image. Hiding a GameObject alone does not remove its Sprite references.

Legacy/direct tests require an explicit scoped fallback owner, not an immortal automatic static fallback or a new GameSystemRoot created by a read-only catalog lookup. Preserve unknown-key/null behavior.
Raw Get/TryGet Sprite APIs alone cannot track caller lifetime. Audit and adapt direct tests/external appearance registration so raw lookups do not silently create permanent borrowers.
Late Destroy must remain safe after Root Dispose; borrow Dispose must be idempotent and use its retained managed owner without native calls on destroyed wrappers.
Failed generation must clean partially-created color/gray textures and sprites and must not publish a cache entry; reacquisition after final release must recreate valid assets.
requiredVerification: Two borrowers share identity; first borrower/root release does not invalidate second.
Final borrow release destroys exactly generated sprites/textures once; reacquire is new valid identity.
Root recreation while old borrow survives does not release old assets or cross-bind leases.
Multiple roots reject or isolate ownership explicitly without implicit global switch.
View hiding/reuse, host shutdown and delayed OnDestroy leave no stale sprite refs/duplicate release.
Legacy scoped fallback/read-only tests do not spawn persistent runtime services.
Native Point/Clamp/palette/alpha/sorting and actual display unchanged.
limits: This is a static reference/ownership survey, not runtime allocation counting.
Generated per-instance gauge/minis/world sprites already have separate owners and are not included in the six-catalog migration.
No image generation, source edits, Unity calls or test runs performed.
